overview.tagline: Focused SEO suite with Domain Authority, rank tracking, and site crawling
overview.description: Moz Pro is a focused SEO platform offering Keyword Explorer, Link Explorer, Rank Tracker, Site Crawl, and AI visibility tracking. Known for Domain Authority and Page Authority metrics, it serves freelancers, small agencies, and in-house SEO teams who need core SEO tools without the breadth of larger platforms.

pick: SEO freelancers managing 1-3 client sites who need rank tracking and keyword research
Small agencies that value Domain Authority metrics for client reporting
Teams that want AI visibility tracking alongside traditional SEO tools
Users who prefer a focused SEO tool over a broad marketing platform
skip: Teams that need PPC advertising data or content marketing suites
Buyers who need daily rank updates (Moz updates weekly)
Agencies managing more than 25 sites without wanting to pay for Enterprise
Users who need JavaScript rendering in site crawls

features.name: Keyword Explorer
features.description: Keyword research with search volume, difficulty score, organic CTR estimates, and Priority scoring that weights volume, difficulty, and CTR into a single number. Shows AI Overviews by keyword.

features.name: Link Explorer
features.description: Backlink analysis with Domain Authority, Page Authority, and Spam Score metrics. Access to a link index of trillions of links for competitive backlink research.

features.name: Rank Tracker
features.description: Weekly keyword position tracking across Google, Bing, and Yahoo. Supports local tracking by city or postcode. Tracks up to 3 competitors per keyword.

features.name: Site Crawl
features.description: Automated weekly website crawls that surface technical SEO issues with prioritized recommendations. Crawl capacity ranges from 20,000 pages on Starter to 5 million on Large.

features.name: AI Visibility Tracking
features.description: Monitor how your brand appears in AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini. Track custom prompts and brand mentions across AI platforms. Available from Standard plan upward.

features.name: On-Page Grader
features.description: Page-level optimization analysis that identifies content issues and provides prioritized recommendations for improving on-page SEO factors.

features.name: Competitive Research
features.description: Compare your domain against competitors using Domain Authority, backlink profiles, and keyword overlap analysis to identify opportunities and threats.

features.name: Branded Reports
features.description: Logo-branded client reports available from Medium plan. Schedule automated reports and customize templates for client delivery.

bestFor: SEO freelancers tracking 1-3 client sites with recurring keyword and rank monitoring
Small agencies that rely on Domain Authority for client reporting and benchmarking
In-house SEO teams that need core SEO tools without PPC or content marketing features
Users who want AI visibility tracking integrated with traditional SEO workflows
notBestFor: Teams that need paid search intelligence or a broad marketing suite beyond SEO
Buyers who require daily rank updates instead of weekly refreshes
Agencies managing 25+ sites without wanting custom Enterprise pricing
Users who need JavaScript rendering capabilities in site crawls
limitations: Rank tracking and site crawls update weekly, not daily - too slow for monitoring launches hour by hour
No JavaScript rendering in site crawls, limiting analysis of modern single-page applications
Backlink analysis depth trails Ahrefs and Semrush in index freshness and coverage
Tight query allowances on lower plans - Starter allows only 75 keyword queries per month
Limited content planning capabilities compared to dedicated content strategy tools
Extra seats cost $49 per month each, making team expansion expensive on lower tiers
freeAccess: Moz Pro offers a 7-day free trial on Standard plan and above. No permanent free plan. The trial requires a credit card. Moz also provides free tools like MozBar browser extension and Link Explorer with limited queries.

alternatives.name: Semrush
alternatives.whyChoose: Broader marketing platform with PPC data, content marketing tools, and daily rank updates. Better for teams that need more than just SEO.

alternatives.name: Ahrefs
alternatives.whyChoose: Superior backlink analysis with fresher index data and more detailed competitor research. Better for link-building focused workflows.

alternatives.name: Screaming Frog
alternatives.whyChoose: Specialized technical crawler with deeper site audit capabilities, JavaScript rendering, and one-time purchase option. Better for technical SEO audits.

faqs.q: How much does Moz Pro cost?
faqs.a: Moz Pro pricing starts at $49 per month for Starter, $99 per month for Standard ($79 billed annually), $179 per month for Medium ($143 annually), and $299 per month for Large ($239 annually). Annual billing saves approximately 20 percent.

faqs.q: Does Moz Pro have a free plan?
faqs.a: No permanent free plan. Moz Pro offers a 7-day free trial on Standard plan and above, requiring a credit card. Free tools like MozBar and limited Link Explorer access are available separately.

faqs.q: What is Domain Authority in Moz Pro?
faqs.a: Domain Authority is Moz's proprietary 1-to-100 logarithmic score predicting how likely a domain is to rank. Google does not use it, and it is only meaningful comparatively against domains in the same SERP alongside Spam Score.

faqs.q: How often does Moz Pro update rankings?
faqs.a: Rank tracking updates weekly, not daily. This is sufficient for monthly client reporting but too slow for monitoring launches or rapid ranking changes in real time.

faqs.q: Can Moz Pro track AI search visibility?
faqs.a: Yes, from Standard plan upward. Moz Pro tracks AI visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini. Standard includes 150 tracked prompts, Medium includes 300, and Large includes 600.

faqs.q: How many users are included in each Moz Pro plan?
faqs.a: Starter includes 1 user, Standard includes 1 user, Medium includes 2 users, and Large includes 3 users. Extra seats cost $49 per month each.

faqs.q: Is Moz Pro better than Semrush or Ahrefs?
faqs.a: Moz Pro is better value for focused SEO work at a lower price point. Semrush offers broader marketing features including PPC and content tools. Ahrefs provides superior backlink analysis. Choose Moz Pro when you need core SEO without the breadth or cost of larger platforms.

editorial.editorial_summary: Moz Pro is the pragmatic choice for focused SEO work: familiar Domain Authority metrics, a clean interface, and an entry price below full Semrush and Ahrefs suites. The core tools are sufficient for most freelancers and small agencies. Limitations appear in depth: backlink analysis trails Ahrefs, query allowances are tight on lower plans, and there is no PPC or content module like Semrush.
